summary: Keep retirement and trim test clocks coherent with the signed-claim forget bound. The daemon's test-only mail-retirement endpoint advances its worker-local simulation clock along with the requested retirement time, and signed trim fixtures use deterministic timelines rather than the wall-clock calendar.

rules.detail: Production signature freshness and signed-claim retention guarantees are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No peer protocol or installed API change; the clock override is confined to test-support builds.

recovery.detail: The simulated clock is released on success, error, or unwind without changing concurrent daemon writes.
